RouteImageSource.description: Where a scraped image URL should be served from. Selected per-request via the `x-image-source` header. Defaults to {@link RouteImageSource.ORIGIN}.

data.description: The decoded payload. Free-form: the script's field set changes without notice.
The `ecData.data` JSON string from a `/web/report` body, or the whole report as JSON text.
The decoded report as objects keyed by field id, its trailer under `_trailer`. Free-form, and lossy: field order cannot be recovered from it.

tree.description: The same report as the `[id, type, value]` tuple tree it arrived as, in wire order, with string and integer leaves in plaintext. Lossless.

data.description: Decoded fields under their mapped names. Fields the version does not map appear as `unknown_<index>`.

header.description: The token's leading bit-field: sign type, flag and mode.

data.description: Decoded records under their mapped names. Records the version does not map appear as `field_<tag>`.

unknown_tags.description: Record tags carried by the token but missing from this version's field map.

truncated.description: A trailing fragment could not be read as a whole record. The records above are still valid.

WebcastFetchPlatform.description: Transport for a webcast fetch, and this API's own query contract. The scrape server's `webcastFetch` route is web-only and carries no platform, so mobile is served by the mobile signing API (see `fetchWebcastMobileUrl`) instead.

Uint8Array.description: A typed array of 8-bit unsigned integer values. The contents are initialized to 0. If the requested number of bytes could not be allocated an exception is raised.

GiftCatalogOrderBy.description: Friendly catalog sort options, mapped to the gifts-server enum below.

content.description: The chat message content to send

targetUniqueId.description:

The username of the room to send the chat to (either this or targetRoomId is required).
Pass room_id = 0 to parameter for this to work.

source.description: Which source produced `data`. `CACHE` / `CACHE_UNVERIFIED` indicate the room info came out of Euler's cache — `CACHE` means its live state was revalidated, `CACHE_UNVERIFIED` means it could not be. Without this, `X-Cache-Hit` is a bare boolean and those two are indistinguishable.

Which source produced `data`. `CACHE` indicates an Euler cache hit. Typed `string` rather than `RoomInfoByRoomIdSource`: the pinned SDK (0.15.0) still types this route's `source` as a plain string. Tighten to the enum once the SDK carrying the room-info enum restructure is published.

alert_creator_user_id.description: The creator's TikTok numeric user id. Unset when the alerts service has not yet resolved it (the gRPC layer carries an empty string in that case).

AlertResponseShape.description: Public, snake_case response shape for an alert. The gRPC {@link LivePushAlert} model is camelCase; the public API has always exposed alerts in snake_case, so we convert before serializing. Only the field casing is changed here — types and field membership are left as-is.

AlertTargetResponseShape.description: Public, snake_case response shape for an alert target. Mirrors the legacy (`old-schema.json`) target shape as closely as the new gRPC {@link LivePushAlertTarget} model allows: field casing is converted, `metadata` is re-hydrated from the stored JSON string, the unix-ms timestamps are threaded back into ISO `created_at` / `updated_at`, and `alert_creator_id` is coerced to a number.

animated_thumbnail.description: The video's dynamic cover; the still again when the video has no animated one.

TikTokUserInfoById.description: Cleaned user profile (deprecated/null/empty fields + author_stats removed). The listed fields are the stable, useful ones; the index signature covers the remaining non-empty fields TikTok returns.

tiktok_user_id.description: Numeric TikTok user id of the agency's linked creator (the "anchor").

icon_image_url.description: Short-lived presigned image URLs — do not cache long-term.

claimed.description: Whether a EulerStream account has claimed this agency.

AgencyCatalogEntry.description: Public (snake_case) projection of a catalog agency row.

WebcastEventListItem.description: List the scheduled/live events for a numeric webcast `host_user_id` via the unsigned `/tiktok/event/list/v1` endpoint on `webcast.tiktok.com`. Unsigned but session-bound — a logged-in user's cookie bundle (sessionid) is required for the endpoint to return data. The route is paginated: `count` is fixed at 20 and the zero-based `page` is translated to an `offset` (offset = page * 20). Use `has_more` on the output to decide whether to request the next page.

TikTokGiftsServerGift.description: One gift row from the ClickHouse `tiktok_gifts` ReplacingMergeTree. Mirrors the searchable columns + the JSON `raw` blob (shipped as a UTF-8 JSON string here so consumers can decode lazily without re-encoding through protobuf any-types).

WebcastGiftGalleryData.description: Gallery entrance payload. Only the fields we model are typed; the rest of the (large) TikTok response rides through as `any`.

RoomInfoFetchApiRoute.description:
Every source that can answer a room-info request.

The complete vocabulary for `source` and `routes_attempted` across the room-info subsystem — room-info producers, the two room-ID producers (`LIVE_ROOM_ID` / `ALERTS`), and the two cache states. The scraper narrows this enum rather than declaring its own lookalike, so a value crosses the wire boundary without a cast: string enums are NOMINAL in TypeScript, and two separately-declared enums with identical members are not interchangeable.

`CACHE` means the payload came from Redis with its live state revalidated; `CACHE_UNVERIFIED` means it came from Redis but revalidation failed.

TikTokUserInfoByIdImage.description: Resolve a TikTok LIVE user's profile card from their numeric `target_uid` via the SIGNED `/webcast/user/` endpoint on `webcast.tiktokv.com`. Signed like a normal webcast route (ttwid + X-Bogus/X-Gnarly) and routed through the caller-provided proxy, but does NOT require a session id. The raw response carries a large `data` object riddled with `deprecated*` placeholders, `author_stats`, and null/empty fields; the route strips those out and returns the cleaned user under `user`.

NormalGiftItem.description: An entry of `data.normal_gifts` — a sponsorable gallery gift.

stream_urls.description: Every playback URL the room published. Always present, but empty for offline rooms and for live rooms TikTok served without stream metadata.

WebcastEventImage.description: Look up a single TikTok LIVE event (a scheduled/subscription stream) by its `event_id` via the unsigned `/tiktok/event/get/v1` endpoint on `webcast.tiktok.com`. No cookies and no signature are required; every query param is a baked-in constant except `event_id` and a generated `device_id`. The request is routed through the caller-provided proxy (the route does not self-select one). Success is signalled by a top-level `status_code === 0` with an `event` payload.

GiftGallerySponsorInfo.description: Current sponsor of a gallery gift (`normal_gifts[].sponsor_info`).

quality.description: Best-known rendition. `UNKNOWN` when TikTok does not label it.

StableStreamQuality.description:
Mirrors of the SDK's `StreamQuality` / `StreamType` enums as literal unions.

Declared here rather than re-exported so the published spec is decoupled from SDK churn — the same reason the rest of this file exists. Same precedent as `RoomInfoForceSourceHeader`.

post.description: The icons captcha requires just one image & a prompt string. ## Example Image ## Usage The `prompt` is the text prompt provided by TikTok. The Icon captcha solution is provided as a list of points, where each point marks a location on the image that needs to be clicked. These points are expressed as ratios relative to the image's width and height. A point of (0.0, 0.0) corresponds to the image’s upper-left corner, while (1.0, 1.0) represents the lower-right corner. For reference, (0.5, 0.5) sits at the exact center. The captcha image selector is `.captcha-verify-image`

post.description: The puzzle captcha requires two images ## Example Image ## Usage The solution to the puzzle captcha is the distance to move the slider to fit the puzzle piece into the background. The `backgroundImage` is the full background image with the missing piece. The `pieceImage` is the small puzzle piece that needs to be fit into the background. The captcha image selectors are: - Background: `.captcha-verify-image` - Piece: `#captcha-verify-image ~ div.cap-absolute > img` The solution is the `x` proportion (0-1) of the width of the background image where the piece fits. It is 1:1 with the slider distance proportion.
